scene: The spicy tea clears your head as the barge docks beside transit hubs.
picture: Flat side-view across an open-air harbour transit concourse. On the far left, a serpentine maglev dragon train sits at a platform. You stand left of centre in your red bomber jacket, holding an empty teacup. Up high centre, a cloud cable pod hovers open beside stairs. On the far right, a pink bullet train waits.
shown: a sleek maglev dragon train waiting open-doored on a platform on the far left
a spherical cloud cable pod dangling open from overhead cables up high centre
a gleaming pink bullet train idling by a boarding gate on the far right
